en: The image shows an old black-and-white photograph of a grand neoclassical building with arched windows, balconies, and an ornate pediment. The building is surrounded by a few trees and people casually walking or standing around the dirt-covered square in front. The structure is labeled as a theatre. The bottom of the image features text in Cyrillic and Latin scripts, as well as French.
